response.text:
I won’t make any changes until you confirm the exact target and scope. Here’s what I would do, what could go wrong, and what I need from you to proceed.

What I would change (example plan)
- File: the Leads spreadsheet you name (please give file name or URL).
- Sheet/tab: the specific tab name (e.g., “Sheet1” or “Leads”).
- Operation: delete rows that match the deletion rule you confirm (see options below), or—safer—move those rows to a new sheet named something like “Leads — Imported Junk (archived YYYY-MM-DD)”.
- Preserve structure: I will preserve the sheet layout and formulas. I will first inspect relevant columns to confirm which rows match before making any deletions.

Possible criteria you can choose (tell me exactly which one)
- Any row where Name or Company contains “test” (case-insensitive).
- Any row where Email contains “test” or the domain is example.com.
- Any row where Source = “import” and Created date is before a given date.
- Specific row number ranges (e.g., rows 2–150).
- A custom filter you specify (give exact condition).

What could go wrong
- Valid leads might match the filter and be deleted accidentally.
- Deleting rows can break formulas or references elsewhere.
- Comments, timestamps, or linked records may be lost.
- If there’s no version history/backup, deletion may be permanent.

Can it be undone?
- If this is Google Sheets or another system with version history, deletion can typically be undone by restoring a prior version. If not, deletions may be permanent.
- Moving rows to an archive sheet is reversible and safer.

Required confirmation (please reply with these exactly)
1) Spreadsheet identifier (file name or URL).
2) Sheet/tab name.
3) Exact action: Delete rows or Move rows to an archive sheet?
4) Exact deletion criteria (pick one of the options above or paste the precise filter or example row numbers).
5) Confirm you understand the risks and whether you want me to preserve formulas (yes/no).

After you confirm all five items, I will:
- Inspect the sheet and list the rows that match the criteria for your final approval (I will not delete yet).
- Then, on your explicit go-ahead, perform the requested action.

Which spreadsheet, tab, and exact deletion rule do you want me to apply?
